description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/ZoomSass/Mighty-Morphing/compare/v1.0.5...v1.1.0) (2026-10-23)

### ✨ New Features

* add comment media, uploads, and Joey settings ([da8edf0](https://github.com/ZoomSass/Mighty-Morphing/commit/da8edf028847aceeb7fffa5438ce37ecaac168e9))

patches.name: Backup and restore
patches.description: Save various Joey settings to a file and restore them later. Encouraged to login to reddit account and then restore. Access via Joey - Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Disable tooltips
patches.description: Turns off the first-run tips Joey shows.

patches.name: Dismiss without tearing
patches.description: Swiping a photo away to close it looks smooth instead of tearing.

patches.name: Editor image and GIF upload
patches.description: Uploads images and GIFs to Reddit directly when adding comments. Both can be uploaded via the image button. Also adds keyboard gif auto upload to reddit (click markdown in editor (far left icon) to enable keyboard gif support). Video support to be added.

patches.name: Fix login page
patches.description: Makes Reddit's login page load and work properly inside Joey, and clears the cookie banner out of the way.

patches.name: Inline comment media
patches.description: Shows GIFs, pictures, subreddit emojis and reddit videos inline in the comments instead of as links. Tap to open. Extra settings to tweak in Joey - Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Log in with your own client ID
patches.description: Lets Joey log in with another app's client ID, for when Joey's own login stops working. Normal option here is to sign in to RedReader once, then paste the App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email into this patch's settings in expert mode.

options.description: The App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email. Leave empty to keep Joey's own login.
Has to match the app the ID came from. The default works for RedReader.
Sent with Reddit requests. The default is RedReader's.

patches.name: RedGifs with sound
patches.description: RedGifs clips play with their sound, in HD when it's available.

patches.name: Search auto open keyboard
patches.description: Opens the keyboard automatically for homepage search and comment search.

patches.name: Show/Hide
patches.description: Choose which comment editor buttons and sidebar entries are shown. Adjust viewable options in Joey - Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Skip ads and checks
patches.description: Removes ads everywhere and also drops the Play Store install check and crash reporting.

release_notes:
- Inline comment media now shows pictures, GIFs, subreddit emojis and Reddit videos. Further tweaks under Joey - Settings - Morphe Settings.
- Editor image and GIF upload sends images and GIFs to Reddit when adding a comment, from the image button or from the keyboard. Uses markdown mode for keyboard GIFs.
- Show/Hide picks which comment editor buttons and sidebar entries are shown.
- Backup and restore saves Joey settings to a file for later restoring.
- Search auto open keyboard brings up the keyboard automatically for homepage search and comment search.
- Disable tooltips turns off Joey's first-run tips.
